data.name: Smartphone Dataset for Anomaly Detection in Crowds
data.abstract: This dataset was collected from the Smartphone sensors and can be used to analyse behaviour of a crowd, for example, an anomaly.

intro_paper.title: Anomaly Detection in Crowds using Multi Sensory Information
intro_paper.authors: M. Irfan, L. Marcenaro, and L. Tokarchuk, C. Regazzoni
intro_paper.venue: 5th IEEE International Conference on Advanced Video and Signal-based Surveillance (AVSS), Auckland, New Zealand,

additional_info.purpose: The key purpose of donating this dataset is to provide an opportunity to the research community to use it for further research purposes.
additional_info.instances_represent: One instance represents a movement patter for a group based activity.
additional_info.citation: M. Irfan, L. Tokarchuk, L. Marcenaro and C. Regazzoni, "ANOMALY DETECTION IN CROWDS USING MULTI SENSORY INFORMATION," 2018 15th IEEE International Conference on Advanced Video and Signal Based Surveillance (AVSS), 2018, pp. 1-6, doi: 10.1109/AVSS.2018.8639151.
